title: Larry NDE 3817
content: I watched myself fall in a kind of slow motion event but I was viewing it from above my opponent's right shoulder, about two or three feet above him. The light that was in the room was different, more luminous but not brighter. The detail of everything around me was incredible. It was like my skin was a sponge, that is to say that I could see in depth I couldn't before. I was completely at peace as I watched this and had no remorse whatsoever. My girlfriend then rushed over to me (the rest of the class was sitting on the floor waiting and watching the fight). She was crying and got down on her knees next to my head and cradled my head in her lap. I didn't understand why she was so upset. I looked at my body lying there and only saw it as an empty shell and had no feelings for it whatsoever. I then felt the need to go back into my body because she was so distraught. I woke up and didn't know what happened at first. She helped me up and my teacher told me to go wash as I had blood on my face. She helped me to the shower and I was totally unaware of who she was. She asked me if I knew who she was, and I replied that I didn't but I would like to, (she was so pretty). When I came back out to the dojo I was still confused and didn't recognize the changes that had taken place in the dojo's construction. (Marty, the new teacher had added an office to the once single room.) I asked where Jerry was (he was my old teacher who had gone back to Japan three months earlier). Marty told me to stop acting stupid and to go and sit on the floor by the door. It was a warm summer's night and we had the door open. As I sat there watching the class, a praying mantis walked into the dojo and sat in front of me. I felt that this was the long dead Master of the style that I studied, (I know this sounds weird but it was such a strong feeling). Someone noticed the insect and yelled and the teacher came over and showed us how the praying mantis fights by taking a pencil and attacking it with it.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Viewing the scene from above the opponent's right shoulder, about two or three feet above him.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Felt the need to go back into his body because his girlfriend was so distraught.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience consisted primarily of an out-of-body viewing of the event, followed by a decision/need to return to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After returning, he felt a praying mantis that walked into the dojo was the long-dead master of the style he studied.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I looked at my body lying there and only saw it as an empty shell and had no feelings for it whatsoever.”
